name: Module depth
responsibility: Judges each bound module's exports from its code, and the math that callers repeat on them
description: Code check hands it each module's exposure, the resolved outside uses, each language's coverage and the module that owns each caller, so it reads nothing twice. It counts exported functions, each public method, exported values and exported types, and the pieces of logic behind them, as evidence. It reports EXPOSED_VALUE for any exported non-function value that outside code reads, CODE_PASS_THROUGH, REEXPORT_PASS_THROUGH when outside callers also import the defining module, EXPOSED_VALUE_COMPUTED when two or more modules write the same math on one exported value, and MODULE_SHALLOW when every non-type export carries a per-name finding. MODULE_SHALLOW is information in the answer; the CLI decides when it fails.
